prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Columbus. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Columbus Ohio for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need two quick clarifying details so I give you a useful, specific shortlist.

1) Which Columbus do you mean (Columbus, OH; Columbus, GA; Columbus, IN, etc.)?  
2) Are you an adult or is this for a child/teen? (affects Invisalign eligibility and providers)  
3) Do you have dental/orthodontic insurance or a budget range?  
4) Any preference (Invisalign only, clear braces, short treatment time, weekend hours, near a particular neighborhood/school/work)?

If you want, I can also just produce a ready-made list for Columbus, OH now (common request). Tell me which you prefer and I’ll pull together 4–6 specific orthodontists to call, with short reasons to call each (experience, board certification, Invisalign provider level, tech used, patient reviews), phone/address, and a quick checklist of questions to ask on the phone.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
